description: Live time injection (UserPromptSubmit + PostToolUse — the model has no other clock). Post-compaction skill-reload gate (SessionStart, source=compact only). Destructive-DB-operation and destructive-git deny guards (PreToolUse Bash), unsafe recursive-delete / mirror-sync target guard (PreToolUse Bash|PowerShell), whole-disk / whole-home tree-walking scan guard for find/grep -r/rg/ls -R/du/dir /s/Get-ChildItem -Recurse (PreToolUse Bash|PowerShell). DX-3347: the operating contract and craft mandate no longer live here — both are folded into the danxbot plugin's mantra.md, printed once at session start/resume/compaction by that plugin's own hook. DX-3350: the convey, tool-discipline and current-time SessionStart mandates are retired the same way — folded into mantra.md as one line each (or dropped where already covered). `convey-mandate.sh` and `tool-discipline-mandate.sh` stay on disk, unwired, because danxbot's production catalog importer still reads them by filename (`src/issues/db/catalog-importer.ts`) until the DX-3340 release removes that reference; `current-time-mandate.sh` was deleted outright (never catalog-required).
